newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India buys 90,000 tonnes of May kerosene-traders.
newsitem.headline: India buys 90,000 tonnes of May kerosene-traders.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has bought by tender 90,000 tonnes of kerosene in two cargoes for deliveries in May, traders said on Monday.

IOC awarded the first cargo to Mediterranean trader BB Energy at a premium over the high of Mediterranean quotes of $34.84 per tonne on a cost-and-freigh basis. The cargo is for delivery May 11-20 to Haldai and Madras on the Indian east coast.
The second cargo was awarded to Shell, at the same price, for May 21-31 delivery c-and-f Madras and Haldia.
IOC purchased just one cargo of kerosene in both its tenders for March and April deliveries.
The April tender was awarded to Total of France at $33.40 per tonne over spot Mediterranean quotes on a c-and-f basis to Madras or Haldia.
The March tender was awarded to Kuwait Petroleum Corp at $34.00 per tonne premium over Mediterranean spot quotes, c-and-f east coast.
